svg.title: Gunsmith: equal starts, different contests
svg.desc: Four original arena studies. Blue A and orange B denote spawns. Bright floors are high ground; stairs have tread marks and both landings. Dashed paths are legal tile routes, with step counts. These are full-information research diagrams, not a player fog view.

g.text: Research 1 • 21 × 13 tiles • matching spawn pairs • random weapons and ring centres retained
Two opposed stairs; equal access to the same high ground.
High-ground route: A 8 steps / B 8 steps. Unplayed candidate.
Equal home perches; test whether both players simply wait.
High-ground route: A 8 steps / B 8 steps. Unplayed candidate.
Two stairs on one face; compare approach exposure with A.
High-ground route: A 13 steps / B 13 steps. Unplayed candidate.
Symmetry passes; all high-ground access shares one stair.
High-ground route: A 13 steps / B 13 steps. ONE shared stair: camping risk.
Pale floor = raised ground. Treads = stairs. Dashed lines = measured routes. Letters identify spawns without colour.
Full-information study: no pickups are placed here. Symmetry does not guarantee an equal outcome or a safe ring escape.
